Accept.description:
Numbers are not typed in. `basis` is an ancestor attempt whose fit reached a Rietveld
stage; phases and weight fractions are read from it.
Accept.title: Accept

AddPhases.description:
Phase edits are their own action types and execute nothing (R13). The page posts an
edit and its refine as one gesture that records both attempts.
AddPhases.title: AddPhases

Adjudication.description: The one correctness-verdict fact. Written only by a sealed_evaluator service (R5).
Adjudication.title: Adjudication

CaseManifest.description: The evidence for one case. There is no field to hold truth.
CaseManifest.title: CaseManifest

CaseSource.description:
Where the case came from. Rights are not here: they are versioned policy inputs
(policy.RightsRegistry), because a license check can change while the root cannot.
CaseSource.title: CaseSource

Cell.description: Lengths in angstrom, angles in degrees. None is a value the parser could not read.
Cell.title: Cell

ChildAttempt.description: R1: actor, typed action, inputs by digest, tool and version, parent, time.
ChildAttempt.title: ChildAttempt

CompletionReceipt.description: Per-completion model identity (measurement plan R19). Recorded even on mismatch.
CompletionReceipt.title: CompletionReceipt

Contamination.description: A canary from custody appeared in bytes bound for, or produced by, the actor (R9).
Contamination.title: Contamination

CorrectMaterial.title: CorrectMaterial

CorrectMeasurement.title: CorrectMeasurement

CorrectionSource.description:
A field set by a human correction attempt. Stamped by `transition`, never sent by a
client: the correcting attempt's digest exists only after it is written. This is the
"expert as a named source" of R8.
CorrectionSource.title: CorrectionSource

DocumentSource.description: A field read by an adapter from a source document or record.
DocumentSource.title: DocumentSource

EpisodeEffort.description: Per-episode effort and cost for the dashboard (R20). None means unknown, shown as such.
EpisodeEffort.title: EpisodeEffort

EpisodeStep.description:
One state transition: the attempt (action, actor, tool, inputs, outcome, origin and replay
manifest) and the derived state after it.
EpisodeStep.title: EpisodeStep

HarborTaskRef.description:
The Harbor trial a scored episode ran in (R31). Trials mount Harbor task copies of a
case, never data/workbench/cases/ itself, so a trial binds to its root by content: the
pattern and every CIF its refines read, by sha256, each equal to the root's (R31).
HarborTaskRef.title: HarborTaskRef

ImportRun.description:
A pre-generated Harbor trial entering the tree as one imported answer (R28) [C1]. Not a
member of `Action`: `store.act` cannot parse it, so an import is never presented as an
action through the shared path. Only `store.import_run` writes it.
ImportRun.title: ImportRun

ImportedAnswer.description:
What a trial's answer file reported. The U6 response contract has no verdict field, so
none is invented (R11): NOT_RECORDED. Reported weights are normalized to percent; the
unit the trial wrote them in is kept, and a reported null stays None.
ImportedAnswer.title: ImportedAnswer

ImportedInvalid.description: An infrastructure failure: there is no answer to read as UNKNOWN [C3].
ImportedInvalid.title: ImportedInvalid

ImportedRecord.description: Captured elsewhere and admitted as history [C1].
ImportedRecord.title: ImportedRecord

Incomplete.description: Missing evidence is named, never synthesized (R11).
Incomplete.title: Incomplete

IngestProvenance.description:
Review-only and deterministic (no principal, no clock). Who loaded the root and when is
a review.LoadEvent annotation.
IngestProvenance.title: IngestProvenance

InstrumentIdentity.description:
Structured identity only. Free-text header fields (sample id, name, comment, preparer)
are custody and never become fields here (R9).
InstrumentIdentity.title: InstrumentIdentity

MaterialContext.description:
What went into the sample and what was done to it. Evidence the agent may see, never
truth. A declared target is what the chemist intended, not what formed (R8).
MaterialContext.title: MaterialContext

MaterialPatch.description:
Section replacement with plain values. `transition` diffs field by field, so only the
changed fields get a CorrectionSource and the parent keeps the original (AE5).
MaterialPatch.title: MaterialPatch

MeasurementContext.description: Acquisition context the tools consume. Corrected with CorrectMeasurement.
MeasurementContext.title: MeasurementContext

MeasurementPatch.description:
Plain values from the corrector. `transition` wraps each changed field in
Sourced(value, CorrectionSource(this attempt)); there is no source field to send [C3].
MeasurementPatch.title: MeasurementPatch

MonochromaticRadiation.description: Single line: BGMN SYNCHROTRON=<nm>. Choosing this for a Cu tube scan drops K-alpha2.
MonochromaticRadiation.title: MonochromaticRadiation

NextAction.description: Typed follow-ups for UNKNOWN, from AGENTS.md (Gates Are Safety Invariants) [C3].
NextAction.title: NextAction

Preference.description:
An explicit pairwise preference naming two digests: the only source of preference pairs
(R5, R18).
Preference.title: Preference

Preflight.description: Measurement plan R19 checks, measured by the harness before the first model call.
Preflight.title: Preflight

ProcessingStep.description:
One ordered step. Processing history decides which phases can form, so each quantity
is typed and sourced rather than a free-text note (KD6).
ProcessingStep.title: ProcessingStep

ProfileAssignment.description:
Copied from phaseeval.refinement.instrument_resolver.resolve_pattern_instrument_policy and the
metrology guard's reason codes (metrology_guard.py:283-294); no new proxy mapping (KTD6).
A stand-in restricts quantitative claims and never blocks identification (R7, AE6).
ProfileAssignment.title: ProfileAssignment

Recorded.description:
A non-executing action (phase edit, material correction, submit, lifecycle): written,
nothing ran.
Recorded.title: Recorded

RecordedPlayback.description:
The demo fallback: a recorded execution shown in place of a live one, labeled as
playback on the page and in the export (AE8).
RecordedPlayback.title: RecordedPlayback

RecordedToolCall.description:
One row of an imported trajectory: shown in the workbench, never replayed as an
action (R28).
RecordedToolCall.title: RecordedToolCall

Refine.description:
BGMN on the current hypothesis's phase set, synchronously, in an isolated directory
(KTD3). There is no phase argument: the phase set comes only from phase edits.
Refine.title: Refine

Refused.description: A valid action the store or executor would not run. Codes name observations.
Refused.title: Refused

ReplayEnvironment.description:
The named allowlist of non-secret environment fields a replay manifest freezes (R4).
extra="forbid": a new field is a reviewed edit here, so no secret can ride along.
ReplayEnvironment.title: ReplayEnvironment

ReplayManifest.description:
Freezes what a re-execution needs (R4). Every field but `environment` must match
exactly for a re-execution to count as a replay (U4).
ReplayManifest.title: ReplayManifest

RunClose.description:
Written by the harness at run close: the transcript's canary scan and the per-completion
model identities an MCP server never sees (R9, R11, AE4).
RunClose.title: RunClose

RunStart.description:
Starts one live agent run. A start whose parent is the root is independent; any other
start is a continuation (assisted).
RunStart.title: RunStart

SealedEvaluator.description: The measurement plan's code-scored verifier. Nothing at the hackathon writes one.
SealedEvaluator.title: SealedEvaluator

SplitAssignment.description:
Copied from the holdout split manifest; the workbench never chooses a split. A lab
case outside every benchmark is `unassigned`. No test or held-out member exists (R10).
SplitAssignment.title: SplitAssignment

Submit.description:
An agent's final answer. The expert's conclusion is a labels.py rubric label and sign-off,
so there is one
way for each actor to conclude.
Submit.title: Submit

TemperatureProfile.description: A logged furnace trace: one temperature per time point.
TemperatureProfile.title: TemperatureProfile

ToolIdentity.description: What handled the attempt. Present on every child, including store-only verbs (R1).
ToolIdentity.title: ToolIdentity

TubeRadiation.description: Laboratory tube: BGMN LAMBDA=<anode>, K-alpha1/K-alpha2 doublet included.
TubeRadiation.title: TubeRadiation

Unparsed.description:
An agent tool call that failed to parse. Written so the agent sees its error and
malformed-use counts derive from the tree.
Unparsed.title: Unparsed
